name: AuroraSwap
tagline: Cross-chain DEX aggregator with MEV-protected routing.
blurb: AuroraSwap finds the best price across 14 chains in one click, wrapping every trade in MEV protection so traders keep what they earn.
description:
AuroraSwap is a next-generation decentralized exchange aggregator that routes orders across 14 EVM and non-EVM chains simultaneously. Its proprietary Pathfinder engine simulates thousands of route permutations per trade and settles through private relays, shielding users from sandwich attacks and front-running.

The protocol has processed over $340M in cumulative volume since testnet, with an average price improvement of 0.42% versus leading aggregators. Revenue is generated through a 0.05% routing fee, 40% of which is distributed to stakers of the AUR token.

name: Mintfolio
tagline: The portfolio layer for on-chain creators.
blurb: Mintfolio turns any wallet into a beautiful creator storefront — mint, exhibit, and sell across marketplaces from one profile that you own.
description:
Mintfolio gives digital artists and collectors a portable, wallet-native identity. Connect a wallet and Mintfolio assembles a curated gallery from your on-chain history, complete with provenance timelines, editioning tools, and one-click cross-marketplace listing.

Over 40,000 creators have claimed profiles, and galleries built on Mintfolio have driven $4.6M in secondary sales. The roadmap includes creator subscriptions and an open embed protocol so any site can render a live Mintfolio gallery.

name: VoltPlay
tagline: AAA on-chain racing with player-owned economies.
blurb: VoltPlay is a high-octane racing universe where cars, tracks, and tournaments are player-owned assets with real, tradeable value.
description:
VoltPlay fuses console-grade racing gameplay with on-chain asset ownership. Every vehicle is a composable NFT whose parts, tuning history, and race record live on-chain, creating a deep secondary market for engineering-minded players.

The closed beta drew 65,000 sign-ups and its first tournament season paid out $180K in prize pools. VoltPlay runs on a custom Solana rollapp for sub-cent transactions at 60fps gameplay, and its economy is designed by former EVE Online economists.

name: LatticeNode
tagline: Decentralized GPU compute for AI training.
blurb: LatticeNode aggregates idle GPUs worldwide into a verifiable compute mesh, cutting AI training costs by up to 70% versus cloud giants.
description:
LatticeNode is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) that turns idle GPUs — from gaming rigs to underutilized data centers — into a global training mesh. Proof-of-computation attestations make every job verifiable on-chain, and a reputation-weighted scheduler matches workloads to reliable hardware.

The network currently spans 9,400 active GPUs across 61 countries. Early customers include three AI startups training diffusion models at a 68% average cost reduction versus hyperscalers.

name: HarborDAO
blurb: HarborDAO lets communities pool capital into tokenized real-world assets — from solar farms to warehouses — with on-chain governance over every dollar.
description:
HarborDAO brings real-world asset investing on-chain with a legal wrapper stack spanning 12 jurisdictions. Members propose, diligence, and vote on acquisitions; ownership is tokenized and yields stream directly to member wallets.

The DAO's first three vaults — a Texas solar array, a Rotterdam logistics hub, and a music royalty portfolio — are collectively yielding 9.1% APY to 5,800 members. HarborDAO's tooling is being white-labeled by four other investment DAOs.

name: ZeroTrace
blurb: ZeroTrace lets institutions prove regulatory compliance on-chain without exposing customer data, using succinct zero-knowledge attestations.
description:
ZeroTrace solves the institutional adoption dilemma: regulators demand transparency while customers demand privacy. Its zkAttest protocol lets banks and funds prove KYC/AML compliance, solvency, and jurisdiction rules in zero knowledge — auditable by regulators, opaque to everyone else.

Two European digital asset banks are live on ZeroTrace rails, with a pipeline of 14 institutions in integration. The team includes three applied cryptographers with 40+ published papers between them.

name: PulseFeed
tagline: Real-time oracle network for exotic data.
blurb: PulseFeed streams verified real-world data — weather, sports, shipping, energy prices — on-chain at sub-second latency for next-gen DeFi apps.
description:
PulseFeed is an oracle network purpose-built for high-frequency, long-tail data that legacy oracles ignore. Node operators stake to attest data from cryptographically signed source feeds, and disputes settle through an optimistic challenge game.

38 protocols consume PulseFeed data today, powering parametric insurance, prediction markets, and energy derivatives. The network processed 1.4 billion data points last quarter with zero successful manipulation events.

name: NomadPay
tagline: Stablecoin payroll for the borderless workforce.
blurb: NomadPay pays global teams in stablecoins with local off-ramps in 92 countries — compliant payroll that settles in seconds, not days.
description:
NomadPay abstracts the messiness of global contractor payments into one API call. Employers fund payroll in USD or USDC; workers choose stablecoin, local currency, or a split — with tax documents auto-generated per jurisdiction.

1,900 companies run payroll through NomadPay, moving $23M monthly. Off-ramp coverage spans 92 countries through 31 licensed partners, and the platform holds money transmission coverage across the US and EEA.

name: Spore Labs
tagline: Autonomous AI agents that trade, vote, and build on-chain.
blurb: Spore Labs ships a framework for verifiable on-chain AI agents — autonomous actors with wallets, reputations, and provable decision logs.
description:
Spore Labs believes the next billion on-chain users are agents, not humans. Its framework gives AI agents secure key management, spending policies, and tamper-evident decision logs, so autonomous actors can transact and govern with accountability.

Over 700 agents built on Spore are live across DeFi rebalancing, DAO delegate voting, and NFT curation. The Agent Registry — an on-chain reputation layer — is becoming the trust standard other agent platforms verify against.

name: Relicverse
tagline: Tokenized museum-grade collectibles with physical custody.
blurb: Relicverse fractionalizes authenticated rare artifacts — from meteorites to first-edition manuscripts — with insured vault custody and on-chain provenance.
description:
Relicverse bridges the $400B collectibles market on-chain. Every artifact is authenticated by independent experts, stored in insured vaults, and represented by fractional tokens with full legal claim to the underlying asset.

The platform has tokenized 34 artifacts worth $12M, and its secondary market clears with 3% average spreads — versus 20%+ at auction houses. A partnership with two European auction houses provides deal flow and authentication muscle.

name: DriftGuild
tagline: The coordination layer for esports guilds on-chain.
blurb: DriftGuild gives gaming guilds treasury tools, scholarship management, and revenue splits enforced by smart contracts — no spreadsheets, no trust falls.
description:
DriftGuild productizes what every web3 gaming guild does manually: managing shared assets, splitting tournament winnings, and running scholar programs. Guild treasuries, lending vaults, and automatic revenue splits are all enforced on-chain.

210 guilds representing 31,000 players run on DriftGuild, with $2.8M in assets under guild management. The protocol takes 1% of automated revenue splits and is approaching operational profitability.
